The PKGBUILD's top-level scope contains only standard variable definitions and array assignments. The `source` array uses a git source format (`git+https://github.com/p4ul17/voe-dl.git`), which is normal AUR packaging practice. The `sha256sums` are set to `SKIP`, which the instructions explicitly state is never grounds to fail this gate — it is required for VCS sources and is an ordinary trust/hygiene choice. There are no top-level commands, variable assignments that execute code, network downloads, or obfuscated constructs. The `pkgver()`, `build()`, and `package()` functions are all defined but not invoked by `makepkg --printsrcinfo`, so their contents are out of scope for this gate. Nothing in the global scope would download and run an untrusted payload or exfiltrate data during sourcing/parsing.
</details>
